title: Only What You Came For
lessons: a purchase can be practical rather than expressive
price is information, not a verdict

text: Your list fits on the back of an old receipt.
The aisles offer thirty versions of every small need.
No one can see the cart as clearly as you can.

choices.text: Buy what is on the list and leave the rest alone.
Add one ingredient for a dinner worth making slowly.

text: The receipt is shorter than the aisle wanted it to be.
Not an upgrade. Just a plan with a smell.
